rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person who interviews.

example.english: This interviewer asked me several questions.
example.traditional: 呢位訪問員問咗我幾條問題。
example.jyutping: ni1 wai6 fong2 man6 jyun4 man6 zo2 ngo5 gei2 tiu4 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the person conducting a job or school admission interview.

example.english: The interviewer asked me to tell them about myself.
example.jyutping: min6 si3 gun1 giu3 ngo5 gong2 haa5 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this for a journalist or media worker interviewing people for a report.

example.english: The interviewer interviewed local residents at the scene.
example.traditional: 採訪員喺現場訪問街坊。
example.jyutping: coi2 fong2 jyun4 hai2 jin6 coeng4 fong2 man6 gaai1 fong1

rows.note: Use this for someone conducting interviews as part of a questionnaire or survey.

example.english: The interviewer asked me the questions one by one.
example.traditional: 問卷調查員逐個問我啲問題。
example.jyutping: man6 gyun2 tiu4 caa4 jyun4 zuk6 go3 man6 ngo5 di1 man6 tai4
